Get your Spotify data

  1. Open spotify.com/account/privacy and sign in.
  2. Under Download your data, select Extended streaming history and request it.
  3. Confirm the request by email. Spotify says delivery can take up to 30 days.
  4. Download the zip from their email and add it to Tracklog. The unzipped JSON files work too.

Tracklog accepts zip or JSON files up to 600 MB. No export yet? You can try it with sample data.
